minutes.headline: Committee moved to release the architects' full contract and asked the town manager to finalize it
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Committee heard the architects' update on building reports, a code review plan, a space needs spreadsheet and the site survey. Members argued against piecemeal approval of the design contract and voted to move ahead with the full contract. They also authorized the chair to write a short history paragraph for Town Meeting and set the next meeting for July 16.

votes.motion: Authorize the architects to move forward with the complete contract as presented and ask the town manager to finalize it.
Authorize the chair to prepare a short report on the committee's history for Town Meeting.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member suggested approving the whole contract rather than allocating services piece by piece. The town manager preferred continuing in stages so items could be reviewed against the financial picture.
Members noted the money is already appropriated and questioned why the work was being approved in pieces.
The architects' needs spreadsheet shows a net program area plus circulation added; members compared it with the total building size.

decisions.decision: Outreach to other town entities such as the senior and teen centers to be put on a future agenda as a specific item.
Next meeting set for Thursday July 16 at 6:00.
Chair to deliver a short Town Meeting history paragraph to the town manager by Thursday.
Architects to find out the next survey dates and tell the town so notice can be given.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to let the architects proceed with the complete design contract as presented and asked the town manager to finalize it; the vote tally was not audible.
Members questioned approving the contract piece by piece when the project money is already appropriated; the town manager preferred staged approvals reviewed against the finances.
The committee voted to have the chair write a short history of the committee for Town Meeting, due to the town manager by Thursday.
Outreach to other town entities, such as the senior and teen centers, was put off to a future agenda as its own item.
The next meeting was set for Thursday, July 16, at 6:00.

why_it_matters: Releasing the full architect contract commits the project to its design phase in one step, rather than in stages that could each be checked against the town's finances before approval.
